review_description: We trusted RACV solar and have had great service in the past, but the installers for our new panels were really problematic. They were swearing loudly, one was heard putting down the apprentice so aggressively that our neighbour complained to us about it. At one point I went outside with my toddler grandson to watch them, and one of them starting singing 'I hate my grandma, I hate my mum because they didn't love me'. I was too intimidated to approach them, and couldn't wait for them to leave. They were probably a one-off, but it was a really unpleasant experience.

The quoting system was very thorough and comprehensive. I had a one hour on-line meeting with the technical / sales representative and was very impressed with the information I received. The quality and depth of the written technical presentation was very high with data for 2 systems to choose from. The sales representative replied to all of my email queries, usually within a day or less. After signing the contract I was told that there would be a lead time of 6 - 10 weeks before my installation could take place, but luckily for me there was a cancellation and the installation happened within 2 weeks, actually starting a day before I expected it! The team leader for the guys undertaking the installation kept me informed at all times and communicated with me all the way through the process. They arrived on site when they said they would, were very polite and finished the job they stared the day before within about 3 hours. There was very little disruption to my work from home day with the electricity turned off for only about 1/2 an hour. The installation itself is very neat, no exposed conduits, or dangling wires. I received all of the compliance documents the day after the installation was complete. My only complaint is the time it takes to organize the independent electrical inspection and final commissioning.

Be very wary of this company who proudly advertise "Fully vetted and reliable installers, from start to finish"Getting this system working properly has taken many hours of my time on the phone and with techs and a lot of stress that I'd bought a lemon!The initial installation was done in December 2021 and all appeared to be fine. At that point I gave a good review of RACV Solar.SADLY that was a mistake.The Fronius WiFi communications module was very poor and intermittently connected to the router so I could often see nothing on the app.  I was advised that it would be much better if hard wired to the router. Luckily I had a couple of spare ethernet ports in my garage!When I opened the comms cover on the bottom of the inverter to insert the ethernet cable, water started running out of it!!When a tech came out to look at it, he discovered that the installation team had drilled a hole in the back of the inverter casing instead of using the glands on the bottom.  This voided the Fronius warranty. Very professional!RACV Solar agreed that it was their mistake and offered to replace the inverter.  At this point I decided to buy a battery as well and got them to quote the whole thing.  I accepted the quote and eventually the team came out to install it all.The installation appeared to go very well until they went to programme the Hybrid inverter (already cabled and mounted on the garage wall.  They discovered they had installed a 3 phase inverter instead of a single phase.  The quote was for single phase and they had the history of my site!!!Eventually another installer came out a few weeks later and replaced the hybrid with the correct single phase unit, but couldn't get it to work initially. After another delay, they came out and got it working.  I finally got the certificate to use the system.Since then, the Hybrid inverter has periodically "Disappeared from the app" so I had no idea about the state of the battery or how much power was coming from the roof.  After a number of visits, one of which found a faulty plug in the inverter, I was told that this unit would also have to be hard wired to the router "where there are 2 inverters one of which is a hybrid, they must be ethernet connected, not wifi" !!  The tech made up a cable to my spare ethernet port in the garage.This seemed to work OK for a number of months, but the same problem started to occur again.  I was told it needed a software upgrade, done, no difference.  A number of visits happened but always upgrade the software and hope!!!Then I was told that the two inverters might be interfering with each other on the server? Really??? Then I was asked to reset the wifi module - remember the inverters are both connected to the router by cable!!After getting nowhere with all the above, I decided to test the ethernet ports in my garage.  I plugged in my laptop and tested both the ports, both were fine.  As I plugged the inverters back in, I noticed that the hybrid connected intermittently as I moved the cable.  I reterminated the Ethernet cable (I have worked in the comms industry for some time) and the system has been up and running since!For anyone with no knowledge of comms, they would still be running around in circles with this level of supportStandard of installation very poorStandard of Service very weak knowledge of the product when there are issuesBeware the claims made by RACV Solar - I wouldn't wish what happened to me on anyone else

I had one company supply me with a quote using a satellite image. They had place all the panels west facing which is the shadest side. I asked them to come and do a on-site inspection but never heard anything back. Another company phoned me, he was nice and informative but didn't provide a quote and I didn't hear from the third.Went with RACV solar. They were very informative, gave me multiple quotes with different systems and battery. I went with the micro inverters but no battery.I've had the panels installed but waiting on an electrician to get it certified.

No problems with the hardware or the installers. However RACV Solar dropped the ball at every step they had.Didn't send the Solar Vic rebate form before the installers where scheduled, so the installers had put in half a day work before they got cancelled.Called someone else about my install, then when realizing they spoke to the wrong person, they left for the day and never bothered to call me. It was sheer luck that the person they called knew me.Was told the the morning after the rebate was approved I would receive a call to reschedule the installers, no call received, I had to call them 2 days later and they still did not know the rebate had been approved. I had received confirmation directly from Solar Vic.Failed to invoice on time for my finance, resulting in the finance lapsing.Lodged a complaint about the issues and it takes me calling them every week to get any action.

Initial interaction and installation was great.After about 3 years however, I needed assistance as the batteries were not charging well.Very difficult to get someone to respond in a timely manner.My system has been operating poorly ever since.  I have had people out several times for a reboot but my system has now been completely offline and not charging the batteries for several months.I can only use a generator to power the house.My last call which was responded to a week later has advised it would be a couple of weeks before someone can look at this system.I think it is time to find someone else who is interested in customer service as the support team rarely return calls.

Of four quotes, RACV were the only one to point out an area of overshadowing I had not been aware of before. They made a few suggestions for alterations (relocating the TV antena), so that I was able to get a decent size system on the remaining part of the roof. Everything suggested was good quality and value for money, and the sales person was happy to answer all my questions before I decided to go ahead with them. The system has been up for a few weeks now, and it's all working exactly as I hoped.

I have a very disappointing experience with RACV Solar. I chose it as one of the largest presumably reputable providers in Victoria. The pre-sales service was great, the engineer explained his approach to my house very well. The installation happened on time and I was advised in advance that I need to have a few spare tiles for my terracotta roof just in case. I was advised to choose Fronius inverter, as "best in class" etc with 25 years warranty.And this is where the service just stopped. The inverter works however despite 5 remote trouble shooting attempts I could not connect it to the App that can tell me the amount of energy my house is producing via Solar.And here is the catch, the money is paid so now no one at RACV Solar is interested in whether I get what I paid for or not. I spoke to them repeatedly (at least 10 times) and guess what? I get promises that someone will call, someone from RACV Solar will come to trouble shoot on site, that the Fronius technician will come on site to rectify the issue (because this is a hardware problem), that the engineer is on holidays but as soon as he is back he will surely contact me, etc. So, all of these "holding statements" and nothing is done over 7 months period. My advice, if you decide to use RACV Solar do not pay the full amount on installation and do not pay the full amount until all your issues are ironed out. The post-service "care" offers no care whatsoever.

Quoting was a little confusing, but that is also the world of solar to begin with.The quote for the installation was for 2 days, with inverter located on our eastern wall, but the installer tried to get me to agree to fit it to the western wall so he didn't have to run the cable under the house. The job was rushed to be completed in 1 day because they didn't want to have to come back (as all sub contractors do to earn a bigger paycheck, better to do 5 jobs in a week than 2.5.).When the installer saw that my house was weatherboard, he told me he didn't have the correct materials to mount the inverter, because it requires cement sheeting for fire safety. Why didn't he supply this? Luckily I had a spare sheet left over from some recent renovation I had just done.They broke my asbestos exhaust vent, which I had photographed prior to works commencing, and then denied it and said they were "nowhere near it"...even though they fit a panel within 100mm of it. After a few weeks we got some rain and I discovered that my roof was leaking through the cable entry point and was flooding the inverter! The company did send someone else out straight away to fix this, but even he said it was a poor install and that we were lucky to find the leak when we did.The most frustrating this is to look at the asymmetrical installation, but that's just nit picking.The whole reason we chose RACV Solar, even though they are more expensive, is so we avoided any poor installation.
Quotation process was fine.Installation was outstanding.  Polite, Tidy, Punctual and workmanship exceptionalAncillary items to the installation all taken care of.

Only supplier who would cover our remote region and give me a system close to what I required. Solar Quotes was not able to provide a supplier here.I have not rated installation or customer service. Not yet installed. Waiting battery subsidy approval

I have had solar service from RACV Solar Gippsland. They initially quoted for, and installed, solar panels on my roof in November 2021. They were organised and worked well to assist me also with the VicSolar rebate application. Since then, as I have been very happy with their service, I have had a quote for a heat pump to replace my old gas storage hot water system. Again, they were prompt, clear and professional in their quoting process, and then supportive while awaiting the VicSolar rebate. They were also very patient with my various queries during the excessive delays by VicSolar. The heat pump was installed in July 2022 and I had good service from it until recently when there was an electrical fault. The RACV staff were very responsive and organised an immediate investigation by their electricians. The electricians were very punctual in their arrival, something that women especially would appreciate as invariably we have to wait for tradespeople to arrive long after the time they specified. They were thorough in their investigation and completed the work in a timely manner. The electrical fault was fixed and they did advise if it recurred, the compressor may be faulty. That was very good to know that they were being clear and truthful and therefore providing useful advice as to what I should do if the problem recurs. I was also very impressed with the quality of the equipment installed as even when the compressor hadn’t been working for nearly 48 hours, I still had sufficient hot water for showers, general hygiene, and washing dishes. I know that if I need their assistance in future, I can contact them and receive helpful and supportive responses.

I was very happy with the product that was installed.Previously, I left a review based on delays in my installation, and I was most pleased that RACV Solar took my concern very seriously. They went above and beyond to get things on track and making sure I was a happy customer

Ended up going with RACV Solar after struggling to get providers to quote due to our 36 degree roof slope. The one provider from Solarquotes who quoted (for a smaller Solaredge/JA Solar system) bumped the a quote up by almost 4k after the technical inspection, so in the end decided to go with the Micro-inverters, premium panels, and slightly larger 6.4kW system that RACV offered.End to end process was really good, from sales to technical inspection, to the install which stretched over 2 days due to the roof complexities (3 angles, part shade). Lead installer knew his stuff and ran a tight ship and the system looks great.Inspection took a couple of weeks which was per their docs and no major issues that side of things. Energy provider took a bit longer and switched me to a really poor Time of Use plan (although FIT @ 8c), so I switched to another provider with a better deal on daily charge and consumption.System has now been feeding the grid for almost 2 months, so looking forward to the end of winter and the daily production exceeding consumption and getting a little bit more FIT.

All aspects of our solar installation process was without issues. Quotes and queries were received promptly. The installation was done well under the lead time quoted. Our installer was fantastic. The communication has been very clear and prompt.

We purchased a system from RACV Solar in March 2022 to replace an existing system.  We spoke with multiiple installers but RACV Solar spent the time in explaining the different systems and options especially around micro-inverters.  We had only a small window to complete the installation and RACV solar worked in with our requirements.  In addition, we were extremely happy within the quality of the installation as we had just replaced the roof.We have also used RACV Solare for other electrical work.Really highly recoomend RACV Solar...
Cheapest quote. Prompt and professional service.very helpful. As soon as rebate approved promptly installed.arrived on time.professional and friendly workers .neat and tidy job.Very happy.John.B

Quoting and sales was as per usual...sell something they cant deliver on...installation was a bit ordinary as well...lol replacing machined screws they lost with self tapping crews....quality plusAt least they were up front on the costsGrid connection was organisef but not permitted to export and still import 75% of my power...lol

I opted to go with Cola Solar as their quote was the best value for money of all the quotes I received. I was really impressed with the speed of the process, as my system was installed within 2 weeks of me accepting the quote. Unfortunately on the day of installation it was only possible to install a 4.07KW system (as opposed to the 5.18KW system planned in my quote) but again the team was really supportive and looked after me. Post installation connection to the grid/commencement of feed-in tariff was smooth and quick. I would definitely go with Cola Solar again.

I had a few small problems with the sales person not understanding several of my questions. After several repeats, I found out what I wanted to know.The installation went very well. The team were amenable to my requests (all cables concealed within walls, care screwing frames over a cathedral ceiling where clearance was limited, inverter location). The standard of work was excellent and was started several weeks before the quoted time.I am now waiting for grid connection as an inspector is not yet available.
Planner was very good and only one to come on a site visit.   I'll do a full review when it is completed

I have no complaints about the actual system works great.the service and attention to detail on the other hand not goodOur install was difficult (skillion roof) and a 30yr old steel profile and they did go the extra mile to find the right brackets.The problem is that after the install we are left with screws poking through the lining boards (still finding these)  of the ceiling and a leak above the Laundry which we had to fix ourselves.My husband had to get up on the roof and fix the damage.Now if they had addressed this when we reported the problem of the leak and offered some assistance it would be fine.All my emails to them (which included pics) got no reply.So in summaryProduct greatInstall not a good jobCustomer service pretty hopeless.J.
Satisfied with all contacts and information/quotes from Great Ocean Solar
Men appeared everywhere and they had a quick and slick install, we're just waiting for the electrical pass to be up and running.

I have recently installed 3.3kw system. I received a call from a sales guy and he stepped me through the process really easily.There was plenty of emails back and forth to work out the state solar rebate. the office guys were only too happy to help.The installation was seamless and good group of guysI would recommend Cola Solar to others for sure
Effective communication, handled all the details including inspection and grid connection, efficient installation, after installation follow up to check satisfaction.

The quoting process was quick.  The quoted price was very competitive, and was adhered to.All staff members I dealt with were polite, well informed and helpful.Cola Solar organised the grid connection. The only thing I had to do was fill out the form for the government grant. The staff at Cola Solar did everything else.The installation was fast and efficient. The system is well located in that it is not obtrusive. The company staff did everything they said they would within their specified time.The Inspector said that the installation was done very well.

Solar 1 Electrical was the one who made contact with me while I worked busily from home.Solar 1 Electrical was very friendly and professional. She was punctual and through with gathering relevant information needed for the install and the quote during the site visit. She was also very technically experienced with what and hold solar panels can be installed. I had a now more challenging rooftop, now that there is an existing 2KW system to work around. I was ready sign with Solar 1 Electrical's reasonable quote for a Fronius 3.7KW system.

I can highly recommend the whole team at Cola Solar. Right from the beginning of the process, of getting quotes to the final installation and start up. All the team have been amazing, extremely helpful, polite, happy to assist with all questions and answers are provided promptly and efficiently. I would have no hesitation recommending the Team at Cola Solar to anyone.

Could not fault this company.From the office to the installers, absolute dream team. We weren’t a normal installation at all. Definitely required them to think outside the box and they delivered and persevered with absolute professionalism.So happy we went with the Tesla battery.  Get a great kick out of checking the app throughout the day!Highly recommend

I took the SolarQuotes information on longetivity & reliability being important, and noted that the inverters are the components that often take wear and fail first.Thus I chose Enphase MicroInverters (which are nicely installed UNDER the Sunpower Maxeons) and I chose RACV (who own Gippsland Solar) as they are a PLATINUM Enphase partner and thus offered 15 year warranties.  So company longetivity plus longest warranty were key factors for me (over price).  18xSunPower Maxeon3 400W & EnPhase IQ7X MicroInverters, Enphase Envoy Switch, RACV monitoring.Happy with the outcome and although there were other quality vendors via SolarQuotes that were also less expensive, RACV + Enphase 15yr was key for me.fyi for Melbourne inner east, PowerCor/CityPower don't seem to be giving ANY Feed-In tariffs any more for new installations

The second time we have used cola solar.  From the initial contact to the faultless installation their staff ,knowledge , punctuality, coordination, professionalism, prompt relies, everything was outstanding.  We would have no hesitation in recommending this firm to anyone

The sales and quoting process was straightforward and clear. They were of great assistance in helping me to apply for the State government rebate - of more help than Solar Victoria was, I have to say. However, I remain gratefull to the State government for providing the financial assistance.The installation was timely and efficient. The installers were helpful and provided assistance to download the Tesla app onto my phone and register the product.I had occasion to have contact with Cola Solar on numerous occasions and customer service could not be faulted. Assistance was always quickly available and I was always contacted in a timely manner if my questions could not be answered immediately.The system is running smoothly, and although I would might like to find a negative or two to this positive review in order to provide some balance, I cannot fault the service I received from Cola Solar from start to finish.

We sought out several local companies in respect to quotes for solar panels on our residential home.  I was so surprised to find that two other businesses did not even bother to return calls when they said they would.In the first instance, Cola Solar of Bendigo spoke to my husband, sent out an information pack via email, including a Google picture of our home with the panels superimposed so as to show how the installation would look.The initial quote was what we expected to pay however closer to installation and without any input from us, Cola Solar made enquiries on our behalf and later advised that we actually qualified for 'Small Scale Technology Certificates' which reduced the cost of the installation for us significantly.On the 29DEC20, Jonathan BEATTIE and his crew of young men attended at 0700hrs.  It was obvious that they enjoy their job and working together as a team, which for me equates to a professional outfit employed by Cola Solar.  The installation took just over half a day and once completed, Jonathan took the time to explain the process including the attendance of the Inspector prior to the unit being switched on.It is not often that I make comment about services provided by companies however on this occasion, I sent an email to Cola Solar to thank them for their efforts, even before I became aware of this feedback page.

Great Ocean Solar have been an exceptional business to deal with. After much research and interactions with other companies GOS's personal and tailored approach, plus the use of quality products is what won us over.  Nikki, Reece and the team were very helpful and informative at every step, from the Rebate application through to the App use and helpful home tips once the system was installed. Very happy Solar customer here, now doing our bit for the environment.
Good to deal with and system seems to be working very well. Can’t wait to receive my power bill

The quoting process was quick and efficient.Installation team were punctual, Job was done quickly and cleanly.Customer service kept in touch during the process, relevant companies were contacted provide the grid connection.Powercor completed their part on 10 Dec, still waiting for Origin to complete the job.(They have responded)
Slick install, good customer service from the installation team. Installation team finished in half a day, after discussing  layout and final electrician sign off
Everything went well good quotes good response times and good follow up.

From the very start of the process, the team at Cola Solar were great to deal with. The customer service in deciding on the best system, following up information and remaining informed of the process gave us a lot of confidence. When the day came to install, the team were fast, friendly and answered every stupid questions i didn't understand about Solar. I recommend the team at Cola Solar because i don't have a bad thing to say about the quality or service throughout the process. Thanks
Installers punctual, informative,System not turned on until inspected this arranged by installers.
Cola Solar are so good to work with. Everyone involved did what they said they would do, on time, happily as me helpfully. Great group of responsive and capable peopleJohn

Everything was clear and accurate from the first contact.     All the work was done on time and very satisfactorily.Absolutely no complaints about the whole process and the staff, both administrative and installers were polite and helpful.

The team at Cola Solar were great to work with from start to finish. They provide a friendly, professional advice and amazing solar and battery installation.We recieved our first electricity bill this winter and when comparing our bill for the same time last year, we seen 55% off difference in cost since we installed a battery and 6.4 kw solar setup. Very happy customer and higly recommend Cola Solar :)

Great company to deal with.  Fantastic communication and service on every level.  Would recommend this company. The quote was spot on and the installation process was very professional. The guys did a great job and were very punctual on the day of installation.
Very good quote with several options. Help and advice with rebate claim. Quick and punctual installation with companies own team. Helped to organise grid connection. Very Happy.

These guys are fantastic, especially Alexis. I had problems with the system that was clearly a powercor issue. Cola Solar worked on my behalf for 6 months dealing with powercor. Not once did Alexis tell me to deal with powercor myself. Now I have a system that is better than I expected. The after sales service is as good as the sales service. When I add a battery to the system I will only go to Cola Solar. I have been is sales for over 45 years and you guys are the best I have ever seen.

Cola Solar were very easy to speak to and I was kept up to date with all aspects of both installations. The installers could not have been any more friendly or helpful. When the jobs were completed, on both occasions, I was left with no clean up to do, very tidy and neat job. All other aspects of the install were attended to by the friendly and efficient Cola Solar staff, ie, inspection, grid approval etc. If you want a professional, well done installation,I recommend you give the team at Cola Solar a phone call.

From beginning to end Cola Solar was helpful and efficient. Installers were polite and informative and I have no hesitation in recommending them. Their office staff were also extremely helpful, happy and courteous. Give them a go
Sales process was simple and effective. Systems not installed yet (house under construction) but they have connected with my builder to arrange access and related details

From the first phone call to the aftersales service was impeccable. They were well-informed and gave us a great system. Even after the Huawei inverter malfunctioned and could have set the house on fire, they replaced it though it was some time before they could due to having to deal with huawei first. The second inverter has been working flawlessly.

From the initial booking for a quotation to the completion of the installation we were kept informed the whole way. A few days after the Salesman visited, an easy to read detailed quote was received, then the installation date was set once the deposit was paid.Very happy with the guys installing the system, especially with the neatness of their work in the meter box and inverter cabling.Once installed the operation of it was well explained and the App installed  on our iPad clearly illustrated how it was working.The system has been installed for two weeks now and have been contacted today by our electricity supplier to arrange grid connection shortly.Overall we are very happy with the whole process!

From our first phone call with ColarSolar to our installation everything was great. The quote process, Vic Gov acceptance response was prompt and helpful. The installation was great, the team arrived on due date at time specified and carried out the work  in a very professional manner and also spent time setting up our account and app monitoring process. Would highly recommend ColarSolar.

Very helpful to begin with until they got the deposit. Then waited over 2 months for anybody to make contact. I eventually called them  to follow up and they said the had to conduct a site visit which would take an extra month. Took a day off work so the visit could be conducted; electrician was quite nice and helpful . One month after the site visit without any contact again I contacted them and they said that it was too hard and wouldn't be doing it. Definitely use someone else
All the people at Cola Solar were polite, courteous and very helpful.  They kept us up date with the process, and we really appreciated their frequent communication and contact with us.
The whole process was very painless. Everything progressed from step to step without any problems.Installation crew were friendly and professional.

Absolutely delighted with the way the RACV walked me through the process From the quote stage to the installation and the necessary final paperwork it was all handled professionally by the solar teamA special mention to Sue for her excellent follow up

We were very impressed in all dealings with this company.There was no stuffing around . From the initial site inspection to the actual installation they came on the days and times that they said they would. The job was completed with the minimum of fuss and the installers were polite and professional.Apart from having to apply for the Victorian Solar Grant myself, the company handled everything else and were extremely helpful during the whole process.I have no hesitation in recommending this company.

Cola Solar have been great to deal with. They were actually the cheapest of the quotes received and a well known name around Bendigo. From the quote to applying for the grant from Solar Vic they were great to deal with. They kept me updated without hassling me with constant phone calls and emails after receiving the quote. They were knowledgeable about the Solar Vic process and happy to help with it.The installation process was easy and quick and to a high standard with the inspector arriving only days later to inspect it. Had a small problem with the wifi monitoring not working but they came around on a public holiday to get it working.Customer service has been friendly and helpful. Recommended 100%

My experience with the Solar Victoria Rebate Scheme involved dealing with the retailer Cola Solar in Bendigo.I found the people at Solar Victoria to be helpful and courteous, given that I was on a steep learning curve and needed to ring back a number of times.Before deciding to go with Cola Solar, I investigated the other retailers in Bendigo. One particularly memorable incident involved a retailer who tried apply for thirty rebates on behalf of customers and only succeeded in acquiring three by using three computers in their office. This led me to enquire with Solar Victoria about whether or not retailers should be making application for rebates on behalf of customers. I was informed that this not meant to happen, as youâ€™re meant to make application yourself.  Another retailer was still in the process of setting up a small rented factory.I was successful in obtaining the rebate only after hitting the â€œretryâ€ button around ten times (you need to be persistent).The office staff at Cola Solar were extremely helpful. Especially given my usual method of finding new questions to ask.For $650.00 and the twelve-month interest free lone, the Cola Solar team did an extremely professional job of installing fourteen panels, the inverter and the other electrical components. A well designed and neatly installed system was the result.Iâ€™m now wondering how I ever managed to live without solar panels giving me free electricity and allowing me to do my bit for the environment.Stephen MooneyBendigo

The whole process from initial visit to reaping the benefits was easy and painless. The quote was accurate and fair the installation was a tricky one as the solar system was placed on the shed roof approx. 60metres from the house. The system was working so well we could not use all the power it was producing and that's saying something with 2 girls in the house.  The solution was to add a Tesla 2 power wall Battery and collect some of the power. Now we have power all night and all day, even in the winter. The system is so good apparently we lost power here for 7.6 hours and we didn't even notice.

Sales person was courteous and knowledgeable of products requested.Installation team arrived when scheduled and provided quality and quick works.Customer service has been in contact via email but I am still awaiting inspection and connection to occur.

Installation was outstanding. Paul and his work mates were thorough, most obliging and helpful in every way. The system was explained carefully and they made every endeavour  to satisfy our needs. I would highly recommend them to others.Re value for money, I find this hard to rate as I had only one other quote which was very similar
The contract installer they used was brilliant. However there communication  via  email in responding to emails was average
Answered all questions promptly.  Were courteous with their interactions.

Cola Solar offered a very competitive quote with high quality brands. They were very knowledgeable and professional, and this was evident throughout the whole process not just the quoting aspect. They have a very cohesive team that works well together, bringing together all the different parts of the quoting, ordering, installation and post-installation. I was kept up to date the entire time with regular emails, and when I did need to ask them questions they were informative and friendly. The panels I initially ordered were not able to be delivered but Cola Solar told me as soon as they were aware of the issue and ended up providing me the same brand panels at a higher kW for no extra cost at their own initiative. The installation itself went very smoothly with no issues at all, as did the final independent inspection. I am very happy I went through Cola Solar and highly recommend them.

On the whole Colar Solar were great, fantastic communication during the entire process.  Everything was smooth and communication to me excellent.The only grip and it's a minor one, all things considered.The after install support did not seem to have a great deal of experience with the Fronius smart meter bolt on option that I purchased.As I was keen to not only have information on the solar production but also on my own electrical usage (loads and production).The Fronius system seems to be reporting that it has firmware updates pending.This system has a admin password that is set by the installer, post install no one appears to know what this has been set to.I appreciate that firmware updates can be risky and a bad one can render a device as a brick.  But It would be an extra benefit to a client any pending updates were handled at the time of the install, rather than left to the consumer to either ignore (and never have the benefits of bug or security improvements) or update and non-technical user risk bricking their components.   The admin password set on the smart meter should be supplied to the client, regardless if they ever intend to do anything with the system or not.I shall follow this issue up directly with Fronius support.
